notes.title: The Vigilante Diaries, from the devs of American Arcadia and Call of the Sea!
notes.notes:
After launching both Call of the Sea and American Arcadia, we are excited to announce that we’re working on a new game: [b]The Vigilante Diaries: An Out of the Blue Story[/b].

In [b]The Vigilante Diaries[/b], you’ll put yourself in the shoes of a working-class man that returns to his hometown after two tours of duty in the Vietnam War, where he’ll be faced with a city ravaged by crime, corruption and social inequality. In this situation, the only way out for someone like him will be [b]taking justice into his own hands[/b]!

[previewyoutube=1pdlvP_SMWU;full][/previewyoutube]

Be ready to recap his life as a masked vigilante, and to define not only his appearance, but also his [b]rules[/b], [b]methods[/b] and [b]red lines[/b]. As you go through his Journal, you will be faced with choices in a raw account of the struggles, hardships and pivotal moments that drove him to become a masked vigilante, and the events that took place after. What kind of crimefighter will you become?

This is the first story of an anthology we’re working on called [b]An Out Of The Blue Story[/b], and each of the stories in it will focus on different characters in very different settings, but with one thing in common: the question [i]“how far would you go to survive?”[/i].

We hope you will like it! You can Wishlist it now, down here, and you can also follow Out Of The Blue on [url=https://twitter.com/OutBlueGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/outbluegames/]Instagram[/url] to stay tuned for future updates.

notes.title: Mixing Gameplays & the Challenges of American Arcadia
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/0893cc904001957a661d999e59217be8c29311ff.png[/img]

Hello there!

American Arcadia is out now, and we couldn’t be happier with the reception it is getting, especially now that we hit the Overwhelmingly Positive on Steam!

When we were developing American Arcadia we thought it’d be interesting to play with someone escaping but also with someone helping him from the outside. To have two different views of the same story, with completely different gameplay. But two different gameplays meant making two games in one. It was a design challenge as well as a technical challenge. And on top of that, we intertwined both perspectives in a CCTV system view. A system we had to design and develop from scratch.

That is the reason why the transitions between both worlds (the side-scrolling and the first-person perspective), are completely seamless. The screens, which have a really important presence in a game like ours, behave like portals where we move from one world to another and, consequently, from one character to another with what appears to be a simple zoom-in or zoom-out, but behind the scenes, it involves a complex system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/172b3b24d87953eb2168b65dbc2a9c61e4127c69.png[/img]

But not only that. Trevor’s escape brings a more physical kind of gameplay, despite Trevor not being exactly the kind of action hero you would imagine. Following that principle, Trevor’s escape is full of action, chases, and physical efforts, things that really take him out of his comfort zone. Even Trevor’s puzzles will be more affected by timing and quick thinking.

Angela’s gameplay, on the other hand, represents her more chaotic, messy and daring personality therefore the contrast comes from exploring, moving stealthily, hacking devices, and using her deductive skills to solve puzzles.

But more than that, our main objective when developing American Arcadia was to constantly surprise the player. Using those three gameplay modes, we tweaked it in different moments to create a thrilling, immersive cinematic playable experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/d61587aece38fb892dab4134914bc3e318c91ea2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/84b836c176ad7e3d941e5d70d8116d2959ca8162.gif[/img]

Don’t be a Fool and stay tuned because we have one more special thing to share! And this one is going to be quite… catchy!

Also, look forward to a patch that we'll have coming soon! There won't be any new content in this patch, but we'll be ironing out a couple bugs that players have found or experienced since launch. We'll have more details about what will be fixed when we release the patch! 

Out of the Blue

notes.title: The References of American Arcadia
notes.notes:
Hello there!

First of all, we want to thank all of you for the AMAZING reception American Arcadia is getting! So a huge thank you from the Out of the Blue Team for the warm reception and the incredible feedback!

And this is especially rewarding considering that American Arcadia was a risky bet from the start: a game about an escape, with two different gameplay styles in two perspectives, who delves into how our privacy and daily lives are affected by the involuntary overexposure that corporate greed corrupted companies impose on us.

We are huge fans of Walt Disney's original project to build an Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow (EPCOT). A metropolis of tomorrow designed to ensure the well-being and comfort of all its citizens. Turning this idyllic arcadia (pun intended) into a place to escape from seemed like a fantastic starting point for our game.

But shortly after we began development, we expanded from that original concept. Thus, Walton Pictures and their founders are an amalgamation of different Golden Age Hollywood moguls, such as Loew, Goldwyn and Mayer, the Warner Brothers and of course, Walt and Roy Disney. But have to confess we also took George Lucas’ middle name to give it to the founding father of Arcadia. 

And for Arpad Kovacs (sorry to all our Hungarian players about the deliberate mispronunciation of his last name, this is a reference to Hollywood actor Ernie Kovacs) we also took some celebrities to create a friendly neighbor hybrid of Steve Wozniak, Fred Rogers and Bill Nye.

But that idyllic Walton Pictures has nothing to do with the media company it became. We wanted to represent how a company born from illusion and creativity can easily end up corrupted by making the worst decisions if they are driven only for cash. Corporate greed is not exclusive to a specific company,  sadly it’s a common phenomenon nowadays.

[b]Diving into the Dystopian Dreams & Nightmares[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/b1320cd6457b1d976427e6d2de635ea718cb608b.jpg[/img]

Being a game about escape, the most obvious references were cinematic. Whether these dystopias are reasonably kind like "The Truman Show" or much more twisted and cruel, as in "The Island," "Logan’s Run," or "The Prisoner," we were interested in all those elements of seemingly perfect societies with a dark side. 

But not only that, we were also interested in other classic elements of escape movies. From classics like "North by Northwest," where an ordinary man has to escape from a conspiracy he accidentally confronts, to "The Fugitive," influenced us. In fact, the character of Agent Gerard in "The Fugitive" was the main inspiration for creating the tireless pursuer Chief of the Interceptors, whose surname is a direct and rather on the nose reference to "Les Misérables."

[b]Setting American Arcadia apart[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/6d94276bc78c4c3044ef8768f6eb25b2894b18f2.jpg[/img]

But we didn't just connect to that idyllic dystopia. We also wanted to make a reference to a much closer and much less beautiful society like the one in the real world. It's not a world so far from fictions like "Black Mirror," where it's assumed as normal to observe the private life of people locked in a place. We live in a world where similar things happen, and we have people addicted to consuming the lives of others or exposing their own.

[b]Pop culture[/b]

In a game about the media, and where audiovisual culture plays such an important role, it was very easy and convenient for us to use pop culture references for our advantage. The game is full of this, but always in a non intrusive way.  Some are direct, but some others are more subtle. The keen eye will find nods to Hollywood movie classics, Canadian progressive rock bands, 21st century manga authors… and even Out of the Blue Games itself!

Follow us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/AmericanArcadia]@AmericanArcadia[/url], where we'll keep sharing nice facts about the game!

[i]- Out of the Blue[/i]

notes.title: American Arcadia is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]American Arcadia is Out Now![/h1]

[previewyoutube=DTjD0oH-cGw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone,

Today is the release day and we are super excited to share American Arcadia with all of you!

In Out of the Blue, we always like to develop new experiences, and we're passionate about exploring new stories in every game. That is why people were surprised by how different the game was from our previous title, Call of the Sea.

Two ideas were really captivating us: the “escaping from a dystopia” theme, which is a kind of story that we all love in Out of the Blue Games, and the 70’s setting and aesthetic, which we believed is not that exploited in games and we find really appealing. So we can say that in the end, American Arcadia was born after combining both of these concepts.  But American Arcadia is much more than a “escape from a 70’s dystopia” game.

We wanted to tackle a more contemporary dystopia: the society we currently inhabit. One obsessed with appearance, likes, and instant gratification. A society dominated by exhibitionism, where personal life seems to fade away, and every aspect of our private lives is subject to external scrutiny. The message we would like to share with American Arcadia is that you don't need to share your life to be happy, because in the end, you are not living your life, you are living a display life for others. Just because your life is simple, it doesn’t mean it has to be boring.

American Arcadia is also a story about cooperation and friendship. And this game would not have been possible if it wasn't for the passion, craft, and care that each member of the team has put into the development. This game is huge in every sense, compared to Call of the Sea, and teamwork was the key.

We genuinely hope you immerse yourself in the world we've created and enjoy this tale about privacy and corporate greed to the fullest!

Out of the Blue

notes.title: Your whole life is secretly a deadly reality show in American Arcadia
notes.notes: We know the setup: A whole group of people life in an elaborately fake place that's actually the set of a sprawling reality show where they—and their lives—are the entertainment. Upcoming "cinematic puzzle game" American Arcadia is just that, a retro futuristic 1970s world constructed for entertainment purposes. Except for one thing: If you're not popular, if your ratings with the audience at home drop too far, you're killed... Read more.

notes.title: Call Of The Sea devs' next game has you escaping a deadly reality TV show this November
notes.notes:
We’ve all imagined ourselves as the stars (or the villains) of a reality show, right? What could we say, how could we act, or who could we woo to bag the ultimate prize? Everyman Trevor Hills - with his office getup, dad-sized ‘tache, and lanky build - isn’t quite so lucky in the upcoming American Arcadia. You see, he’s unknowingly stuck in a reality TV show where the penalty for unpopularity is death, and considering he has the personality of a pencil, his only option is to escape in genre-bending fashion. See below!

Read more

notes.title: In the Shadow of Dreams: The Untold Story of the First Arcadia
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a2c0ec288a4c8d9bf437efb7d719604642632092.png[/img]

We are getting closer to American Arcadia’s season premiere, but this time we want to take a look back and dig into Arcadia’s past and how it became the perfect city for luxury and comfort that it is today.

Arcadia was never meant to be a big megalopolis. In fact, it began as a dream in the mind of a visionary filmmaker turned city planner. Today, we delve into the captivating history of Project Arcadia, a city that was conceived by the legendary Elijah Walton and brought to life by his unwavering determination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a4c0a8e680952250aaab00c49611a7b78a7870db.png[/img]

[h1]Elijah Walton: From Small-Town Dreamer to Hollywood Luminary[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/fa639809e4aef23bf1072a68b9c88c658e6dbdee.png[/img]

Elijah Walton's journey began in the quiet corners of Minnesota, where he was born in 1900. From a young age he was captivated by the works of Jules Verne, who fueled his dreams of becoming a novelist or scientist. However, destiny had other plans and lead him to the bustling world of Hollywood's film industry.

In the 1930s, Elijah, alongside his brother Donald, founded Walton Pictures. Together they embarked on a cinematic journey that produced numerous box office hits, many of which have since become timeless classics. Yet, Elijah yearned for something more, a way to reach a broader audience beyond the silver screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/7eef34267ed8f1c47b14859868cee88b06e859dd.png[/img]

[h1]Architects of Tomorrow TV Show: A 1950s Sensation[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a259378f013298a5fbcb48f257caedd936aaf4cc.png[/img]

The breakthrough came with the advent of television, as the innovative 3D audio and video system, Visi-O-Rama, brought forth the legendary "Architects of Tomorrow" TV show. A Saturday night staple in the 1950s, the show was renowned for its unique songs, the seamless blend of live action and animation, and the heartfelt goodbye message delivered by Elijah Walton himself as he cruised away in his prototype electric car, aptly named The Waltonmobile.

[h1]Project Arcadia & Walton's Dream Unfolds[/h1]

The pinnacle of Walton's ambitions arrived when Walton Media, formerly Walton Pictures, set its sights on an audacious project—the creation of a city of the future, Arcadia. Alongside his trusted partner and "Architects of Tomorrow" host, Arpad Kovacs, the first prototype of the Arcadia Project began to take shape. Today, this prototype community is known as 'Classic Arcadia' or 'Old Arcadia.'

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/057d96570ef943e7a68e22efeef2d5b09a6a97d2.png[/img]

[h1]The Tragic Loss of Elijah Walton[/h1]

Tragically, the visionary mind behind Project Arcadia would not live to see his magnum opus completed. On June 3rd, 1963, the world lost one of the 20th century's most talented minds to a sudden heart failure.

In the wake of his brother's passing, Donald Walton stepped up to lead the company. Under his stewardship, Project Arcadia was brought to fruition according to its ambitious schedule.

[h1]The Unveiling: American Arcadia's Premiere[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/50e630e795b5ad1eee5a62b2600e4c80a20b1e3d.png[/img]

American Arcadia's premiere was an event that rivaled even the Apollo XI Moon landing in viewership. Yet, what the first residents of Arcadia didn't realize was that their private lives were being broadcasted to the nation.

[h1]Arcadia's Meteoric Rise and the Burbank Act[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/232bbf134abdd06fca431d9a716ad8311f37d4be.png[/img]

The city's success drew a flood of new residents, rapidly outgrowing Old Arcadia. It was clear that a larger, more modern city was needed to fulfill Elijah Walton's grand vision. Through the collaboration between Walton Media and Senator Milton Burbank, the Burbank Act was passed, allowing Arcadia to expand to the size that had always been envisioned.



So, if you've been intrigued by the tale of Project Arcadia and want to dive deeper into its mysteries, we encourage you to stay tuned for the release of American Arcadia!

Be among the first to explore this fascinating narrative and immerse yourself in a world where a perfect life is nothing but a perfect lie. 

Follow us on Twitter at @AmericanArcadia and if you haven’t done it yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia/]wishlist American Arcadia[/url] today on Steam 

Out of the Blue

notes.title: The People and Brands of Arcadia
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/f19aa30eba62514a12337f2b62bf46967d741ffb.png[/img]
Hello there, American Arcadia fans! 

Welcome back to an exciting edition of American Arcadia Insider, where we immerse ourselves in the captivating world of your beloved show. In this special issue we're taking a deep dive into the lives of Arcadia's most prominent figures as well as the indulgent, stylish, and iconic brands that have woven themselves into everyone's favorite City of Tomorrow. 

From aerobics champions to disco divas, to thirst-quenching refreshments and stylish rides. Join us on an adventure into the famous People and Brands of Arcadia – this is a journey you won't want to miss!

[b]THE RISE OF A GOLDEN BOY[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/717117e1d780fba7c721ea0a0c95fa47bc924298.png[/img]
Our journey into the heart of Arcadia's celebrity scene starts with none other than [b]Steve Just[/b], the four-time world aerobics champion. Affectionately known as "Aerobics" Steve, he's not just a champion in the gym but also a sensation on the dance floor. 

A disco party hosted at Steve's opulent Arcadia Spire penthouse has achieved [i]legendary[/i] status, where the elite of Arcadia gather to revel in the night's pulsating energy.

[b]WHERE GROOVY VIBES COME ALIVE[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/78ffd29482c9b062b3eb008c97e6a2504c693498.png[/img]
Speaking of the pulsating energy, our next stop takes us to the top of the Spire building where the Limelight Club resides. Owned by the magnetic [b]Vivian Walton[/b], this club is a temple of groovy vibes that can ignite anyone's desire to dance. 

[b]DJ ZOOM IS IN THE ROOM[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/18096cdd0b5bd2651e4e2b64dd44350ed4ff6b64.png[/img]
The dancefloor truly comes alive when [b]DJ Zoom[/b], also known as Clive Saddler, takes control of the turntables. Not only is he Arcadia's top DJ, but he's also the charismatic host of Hits in WBAC, Arcadia's radio station that fills the airwaves with the finest tunes around the clock.

[b]CHART-TOPPING SENSATION[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/237b4e55bb8a0f9d15a5f95cc4e66b111a417277.png[/img]
If you're seeking chart-topping hits, look no further than [b]Merle Jefferson[/b]. With her third studio album "Regular Girl," Merle has skyrocketed to fame, with her single "Don't Be a Fool" reigning at the #1 spot for an impressive six weeks. 

This catchy tune has captivated the hearts of listeners everywhere, but beneath the melody lies an intriguing story. While Merle claims the song is a reflection of her personal experiences, rumors swirl that it might have been inspired by the turbulent relationship between Steve Just and model Tiffany Amber Gaines!

[b]THE DISCO DIVA[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/46a9aa930a1c1e4efadcb125b94be69a2362662f.png[/img]
[b]Tiffany Amber Gaines[/b], a name that resonates with anyone familiar with the vibrant world of Arcadia. Introduced during the second season of Singles Mixer, Tiffany quickly became the Most Desired Arcadia Single, winning the hearts of viewers with her charisma and elegance. Supported by her dedicated fanbase, fondly dubbed "Tiffaniers," Tiffany embarked on a successful modeling career. Interestingly, her rise to fame was not without a hint of intrigue, as rumors suggest her journey was intertwined with the heart of "Aerobics" Steve Just.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Now, let’s embark on a special issue featuring some of the American Arcadia most relevant and iconic brands!

[b]BLITZ COLA: QUENCHING THIRSTS AND IGNITING SPIRITS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/b90bd8638dd3b69fcef4da9b9c424e5cabc6c119.png[/img]
Are you in pursuit of the ultimate refreshment? Look no further than [b]Blitz Cola [/b]– the beloved nectar of Arcadia and the most popular soda in the world! With its effervescent flavors and invigorating fizz, Blitz Cola has etched itself as the quintessential choice for the city's residents. From bustling city streets to tranquil park benches, a chilled bottle of Blitz Cola is an ever-present companion.

Even our energetic Angela, a central figure in the Arcadia narrative, has declared herself a devoted Blitz addict. This fizzy elixir isn't just a beverage; it's an integral part of Arcadia's lifestyle. Beyond being a refreshment, Blitz Cola is a pioneer in crafting immersive brand experiences. The Blitz Festival, an electrifying celebration of life and energy, is a testament to the brand's commitment to infusing excitement into everyday moments.

And what's a prominent brand without an equally prominent ambassador? For Blitz Cola, there's a standout figure who embodies the brand's values and vitality, and that person is Steve Just. So, let's raise our glasses to Blitz Cola – the drink that fuels Arcadia's vibrant spirit! 

[b]SWIFT RENTAL CAR: SPEED MEETS STYLE[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/2652bf4dfd15f3ecd2ee228b0bc9d91ae0673711.png[/img]
In a city where speed and style intertwine, [b]Swift Rental Car[/b] stands as the epitome of both. If the need for speed courses through your veins, Swift Rental Car offers a fleet of the coolest rides exclusively for the Arcadian roads. 

Imagine cruising through the city's avenues in a sleek and stylish vehicle, the wind tousling your hair as you embrace the exhilaration of the open road. With their main office nestled within the Blue Fountain Mall, Swift Rental Car has established itself as the go-to destination for those seeking a taste of adventure with a dash of sophistication. 

Whether you're exploring Arcadia's urban landscape or venturing beyond its borders, Swift Rental Car ensures that you do it with a flair that's unmistakably Arcadian.

[b]A MOMENT OF TRANQUILITY WITH GUSTO[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/d707a4f02e18cd5caae483958bd92f7a1fcbe166.png[/img]
In need of a moment of relax to enjoy on your own?

In the midst of the city's bustling energy, sometimes all you need is a moment of serene indulgence. Enter [b]Gusto [/b]– the embodiment of relaxation and refined taste. With every sip of Gusto's 100% American Cappuccino, you're transported to a world of calm and delight. It's not just a coffee; it's a journey into the realm of personal enjoyment.

The aroma, the taste – it's like a mini-vacation in every sip. Enjoy your day with Gusto, just for you.
 
This luxurious experience, tailor-made for the discerning palates of Arcadia, is a testament to the city's commitment to enhancing the quality of life for its residents.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

As we conclude this exploration of Arcadia's brands, remember that these are just the beginning of a tapestry woven with innovation, style, and identity. Stay tuned for more insights as we continue our journey through the rich fabric of Arcadia's iconic brands that shape its past, present, and future.

As the curtain falls on this chapter of our exploration, remember to stay connected with @AmericanArcadia on social media for the latest updates and insights from your favorite show. The City of Tomorrow has so much more to offer, and we can't wait to continue this exhilarating journey through its captivating tapestry of people, places, and stories.

Until next time!

notes.title: American Arcadia: All We Know So Far
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/214141002737cd648b9623c83e75d7caa7691aa0.png[/img]
Hello there!

We have been working hard on American Arcadia, hence the radio silence here. But we are back 📺 and ready to dig deeper into Arcadia’s little secrets.

Curious about them?  Let’s first do a little recap about All we know about American Arcadia so far, and maybe unveil a couple of new things that will have a wider explanation as we get closer to the release date.

Here are some fun facts about the most watched media phenomenon on the planet!

[h1]IT'S ALWAYS SUNNY IN ARCADIA[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/5756e63b3b6da09048f691cecd244868969cf6ad.jpg[/img]

American Arcadia is set on an immense 43-square-mile retro-futuristic metropolis suspended in time. Inside it, under a weather-controlled dome,  their citizens enjoy an endless spring throughout the whole year.

[h1]A DIFFERENT KIND OF 1970'S[/h1]

Arcadia’s citizens enjoy a life of luxury and comfort, filled with all types of modern conveniences, like cleaning robots, drones, electric cars… all carefully designed to look like 1970’s props!

[h1]ALWAYS LIVE![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/8b93d2ec310d08802d29a85155050aed47fa3a5a.jpg[/img]
Broadcast live 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, on every digital platform, American Arcadia has a complex system of thousands of cameras which registers the everyday lives of their 23.414 Arcadia-born citizens.

[h1]ARCADIA'S #1 CELEBS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/610bb4b8287090f563bc54cdf8a8e4ac5ae72bcd.png[/img]
And who are the most famous Arcadia citizens? Of course number one still is the aerobic world champion [b]Steve Just[/b], followed by his girlfriend, supermodel [b]Tiffany Amber Gaines[/b]. Among others are music [b]DJ Zoom[/b] or singer [b]Merle Jefferson[/b]. These people get American Arcadia’s ratings go high, and everything that happens to them, from love to drama is commented live and followed by millions of viewers.

[h1]"LIVE FROM THE ARCADIA DOME, I'M YOUR HOST, VIVAN WALTON"[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/5c9dbc2c921d80af37ff80690af9df1765e9a3bb.png[/img]
And what would be of American Arcadia without the true star of the show? Arcadia´s city representative, club owner, and caustic show host… the one and only Vivian Walton! 
There is a lot to share about Miss Walton, but we will leave that for another blog.

[h1]TUNE IN FOR THE 55TH SEASON![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a9150b1fe987c874ecc97c0ed40fa4853fac43c6.png[/img]
Are you ready for the 55th season?
Login to your AA Live app and vote, comment and be a part of... American Arcadia!

Make sure you follow [url=https://twitter.com/AmericanArcadia]@americanarcadia[/url] so you don’t miss out on the new things we’ll be showing soon!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/088ee9aa4917949369533fb63ff03051487ee8d8.png[/img]

[h3]Hi there Arcadians![/h3]

Some weeks ago we travelled to Cologne to attend Gamescom, where we spent some lovely days presenting American Arcadia to the European press.

Out of the Blue’s co-founder and Creative Director Tatiana Delgado and Lead Writer Alfredo Gonzalez-Barros were there to keep American Arcadia's ratings rising and giving the press a sneak peek of the full game in our first European hands-on demo. To help them remember us better we also provided a little device to help block unwanted observation - you never know who might be watching ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/ef66590251a7ce07c38ebf8f200e4d72a914a1bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/be2ce29c128808935a5f3f7e99275c6316c24afa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/2079e3a256f7136c27ea5324d720e65640f323a8.png[/img]

We received amazing feedback from Gamescom and also a lot of questions concerning the plot of the game, the characters, and the mechanics:

[i]“I was just so engrossed in the game's mixture of side-scrolling platforming and first-person puzzling. Keep American Arcadia under surveillance, because I think it's going to be a real hit when it lands.” [/i]
- [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/american-arcadia-is-a-genre-flipping-cinematic-feast-from-the-call-of-the-sea-devs]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

[i]“American Arcadia is shaping up to be something really special. The Truman Show-style set up is familiar, but the way that Out of the Blue has realized this kitschy 70s utopia is simply wonderful. The way they then contrast it with the second viewpoint and blend more ideas into the side-scrolling escape makes it really feel like American Arcadia will be more than the sum of its parts.”[/i] 
- [url=https://www.thesixthaxis.com/2022/09/08/american-arcadia-preview-on-the-run-in-a-murderous-70s-utopia/]TheSixthAxis[/url]

For any [url=https://www.actugaming.net/apercu-american-arcadia-un-jeu-daventure-a-la-truman-show-qui-donne-envie-517003/]French[/url], [url=https://www.ingame.de/tests/american-arcadia-preview-gameplay-story-gamescom-2022-spieler-koeln-91752195.html]German[/url], or [url=https://ordenpixel.com/american-arcadia-primer-contacto/]Spanish [/url]fans, you can read similar impressions here! 

All in all it was a fantastic week, and so refreshing to sneak out of the Arcadia bubble and spend some time in the Gamescom bubble. We’re back at home working on the game now, but also planning our next escape! So stay tuned!

If you’d like to get the latest info on American Arcadia you can follow us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/AmericanArcadia]@AmericanArcadia[/url] and please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia/]wishlisting us on Steam[/url] - it really helps indie developers!

Thanks, and stay groovy until next time -
Out of the Blue

We've had a pretty exciting and nonstop few weeks and we're happy to be able to have some time to go through all the fun events and happy news in this recap.

On June 9th the team assembled for the [b]#SummerGameFest[/b] where American Arcadia’s official trailer was being shown to the public! 

[previewyoutube=nxszwetB-Lg;full][/previewyoutube]

It was really special to be able to share and watch the event together and enjoy people's first reactions to the game across social media. But the fun was only beginning, because the next day part of the team flew to New York to attend [b]The Tribeca Festival![/b]

We previously mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia/]one of our blog posts[/url], that American Arcadia was selected as part of the [b]Tribeca 2022 Festival Games[/b] program. What a great reason to flee Arcadia’s dome and go on a mini adventure to the city that never sleeps!


We really enjoyed watching people trying to escape from Arcadia in our very first demo. The booth displayed some exclusive concept art that players loved. We were also featured in the Tribeca Spotlight at the [b]Summer Game Fest[/b] with a documentary about the making of American Arcadia.

“[i]While I've only played for just a short while during the Tribeca Festival demo, America Arcadia has quickly become one of my most anticipated upcoming indie releases. This is definitely one to watch out for.[/i]” [b][url=https://www.gamesradar.com/american-arcadia-preview/]GAMES RADAR +[/url][/b]

“[i]American Arcadia Is Reviving The Long-Lost Art Of Multiple-Perspective Games[/i]” - [b][url=https://kotaku.com/american-arcadia-preview-raw-fury-call-of-the-sea-tribe-1849101531]KOTAKU[/url][/b]

Now we have returned under the Arcadia dome, back working on the game and looking forward to showing and telling you more about American Arcadia soon!

notes.title: American Arcadia Full Trailer Premieres at Summer Game Fest
notes.notes:
[b]Some months ago we showed you a sneak peek of American Arcadia when we announced it had been nominated for the Tribeca Festival 2022 Games Selection.[/b]

Now we are proud to present the official trailer reveal that has just been unveiled at Summer Game Fest tonight!

[previewyoutube=nxszwetB-Lg;full][/previewyoutube]

This world premiere gives players the first detailed look at our upcoming 2.5D platformer and first-person puzzler, where players explore the unique stories of two characters – each with their own distinct gameplay – whose lives and fates are intertwined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/c4b4019f2cf70818a7fbdcfb3f8ed99c1913c333.png[/img]

"As we did with Call of the Sea, we wanted to move into a world that was evocative for us. We like to create worlds that are striking, visually appealing, and evocative," commented Daniel Nombela, our Art Director at Out of the Blue. "We also like to give them a twist and in this case, we have chosen a bright and colorful vision of the 70's. The characters, the environments, and even the furniture represent this utopian and kitsch version of a city of the 70's."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/6f4e97dd0880f87579e38cbea60528f5c0f86e36.png[/img]

“Trevor Hills is just an average person, living a mundane life and enjoying his daily routine; it's the little things that make him happy,” says Tatiana Delgado, the co-founder and Creative Director at Out of the Blue. “In the real world that wouldn’t be a problem, but in Arcadia, where citizens are secretly being broadcast live, 24/7, not being popular enough means trouble. So when Trevor realizes that everything is a lie and that the show wants to get rid of him, his life changes completely.”

But Trevor finds help from a mysterious voice promising to guide him through American Arcadia's backstage to his freedom. Is this offer real, or merely a gimmick to raise audience ratings?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/10f5eff0b2b0c2a98f2174fea527ee0848510d7a.png[/img]

"In American Arcadia, nothing is what it seems, and we have tried to convey that idea in the puzzles as well,” declares Álvaro González, our Lead Game Designer. "In most cases, the solution is never what it initially seems. The player will always have to use logic and deduction to figure out how to solve the situations presented to them."

We hope you enjoy this glimpse into the world of American Arcadia - if you want more info on the game please consider wishlisting it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia/]here on Steam[/url], and follow [url=https://twitter.com/AmericanArcadia?s=20&t=Qs5SjWECHZKT-zP1eXYZPA]@AmericanArcadia[/url] on twitter and [url=https://www.instagram.com/americanarcadiagame/]@AmericanArcadiaGame[/url] on instagram - thank you!

Stay Groovy,
Out of the Blue

notes.title: Call Of The Sea dev's latest is a mix of The Truman Show and Logan’s Run
notes.notes:
The studio behind the 1930s supernatural mermaid-filled adventure Call Of The Sea have announced their next game, and it looks like a tonally bang-on pastiche of reality shows, social media saturation and 1970s dystopian sci-fi. Published by Raw Fury, American Arcadia centres on Trevor Hills – an average bloke in flares, tank top and ‘tache – who is a bit too boring to survive the unwitting reality-show metropolis of Arcadia where he lives. Cue a mysterious guide who may or may not be trying to help Trev escape. It's good to hear that Yuri Lowenthal and Cissy Jones are back on voice duties, presumably as Trevor and his new pal, after their top-notch performances in Call Of The Sea.

notes.title: Announcing: AMERICAN ARCADIA
notes.notes:
After all these months, we here at Out of the Blue Games are extremely happy to finally share with you what we have been developing:  American Arcadia. And once more, we are working together with our friends at Raw Fury to make it a reality.

[previewyoutube=jL4lH_fdRL8;full][/previewyoutube]

American Arcadia is a thrilling single player experience that combines two gameplay styles, a 2.5D action side-scroller including challenging platform action, breath-taking chases, stealth and puzzles. As well as a full 3D first-person game, with hacking, exploration, stealth elements, and puzzles to solve.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/d14d2ec61e13b225d1c48f3907e3bf85aa70dcaa.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/5532b04e6afbf25d5215c80fd43b0f37b550e307.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/c73b5a7d4a5aa046d6805b698de7e2c3b5fc828a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/2215d0c71f68a8f20d8e88a6cf22947e58f16b6e.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/38a9738c713a75aa789bfdfd0160a20875d7ebd8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/b75fb81aaa7c4a0c549d2d3e3c90d478d55fdd4a.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/f5b7044872a354ef4880948f5cd2ae4362a3d0f3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/f73112ea95eb07b5e554cd196a5912d23ee9f265.jpg[/img][/url]

The game takes inspiration from movies and TV shows like [i]The Truman Show[/i], [i]Logan’s Run[/i] and [i]The Prisoner[/i]. As in [i]Call of the Sea[/i], we love to create striking visually appealing worlds, and in this case we have chosen a bright and colorful version of the 70's. The characters, the furniture, the environments, represent this utopian and kitsch version of a 70's city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/746b1b18d94adda14225b636d39483b2ba736446.png[/img]

In our games, we like to design characters that are not what you would usually expect in a video game. Meet Trevor Hills, an average man enjoying a mundane life in Arcadia, the retro futuristic 70's city that is nothing but a huge TV set for the most watched reality show in America. Meet Angela Solano, a Puerto Rican stage technician that works for the show and will help Trevor escape. But these characters wouldn’t shine if it wasn’t for our amazing cast. We have Cissy Jones and Yuri Lowenthal on board again, because we absolutely adored their performances as Norah and Harry in Call of the Sea. And we welcome the talented Krizia Bajos to the cast, and many more.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/42748eb261fc988e3b14272a89eb8849fd81a3a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/cdd443ced5d24608079330179db00dd0e1db516b.png[/img][/url]

We are also really proud to share that American Arcadia has been selected as part of the Tribeca Festival 2022 Games Program.

So if you want to be up to date with the latest news about American Arcadia, follow us on our social networks, don’t forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia]here [/url]in Steam and stay tuned for the full reveal trailer at the Summer Game Fest!

On behalf of the whole Out of the Blue team, we hope you like it!
